narrative.intro: Axiom Space obligated $213M in federal contract dollars in FY2026 to date across 7 awards. Axiom Space's average award size was $30.4M, and Axiom Space's obligations are up 62.7% year over year. Axiom Space's obligations rose from $1.7M in FY21 to $48.4M in FY22, $75.2M in FY23, $134M in FY24, $131M in FY25, and $213M in FY26. The National Aeronautics and Space Administration obligated $213M in FY2026 to date for Axiom Space. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing is Axiom Space's largest NAICS market at $211M, with Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) at $1.7M. The current-year totals are partial, reflecting fiscal year to date obligations rather than full-year results. This profile reflects contract obligations rather than total contract values, except where award-value figures appear in separate awards tables.
